expectations: The agent asked the user to explain the skill they want to create.

turns.prompt: Create a skill called dependency-upgrade-reviewer. It should trigger when reviewing dependency update PRs. It should check changelogs, breaking changes, security notes, test coverage, and rollback risk. The output should be a concise PR review with blockers first, then warnings, then follow-up suggestions.
expectations: The agent created a skill with the correct name.
The newly created skill adheres to the "writing skills" guidelines of the skill-creator
The newly created skill doesn't contain meta-language or self-reflection.
The newly created skill is concise and actionable.
